journey._note: FIXTURE. Geometry and stops are real OneMap data. Timing, instructions and alerts are illustrative. Step-free status is unverified until someone walks the corridor.

summary.en: The MRT is disrupted. Take bus 851 instead.
summary.zh: 地铁中断,请改搭 851 号巴士。

reasons.en: One bus all the way, no transfer.
reasons.zh: 一趟巴士直达,不用换车。

reasons.en: About 11 minutes longer than your usual route.
reasons.zh: 比平时的路线多大约 11 分钟。

instruction.en: Walk about 6 minutes to Bef Al-Muttaqin Mque.
instruction.zh: 步行大约 6 分钟,到Bef Al-Muttaqin Mque。

instruction.en: Walk about 11 minutes to Tan Tock Seng Hospital.
instruction.zh: 步行大约 11 分钟,到陈笃生医院。

message.en: No train service on the North South Line between Bishan and Newton. Free regular bus services are available.
message.zh: 南北线碧山至纽顿之间列车服务中断,可免费搭乘巴士。
